cases.explain: The transitive verb осадил (besieged) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Заключи с нами ___, и мы будем подчиняться тебе.
cases.explain: The transitive verb заключи requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Я заключу с вами союз только на том условии, что выколю каждому из вас правый глаз, и так покрою бесчестием весь ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb покрою requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда вестники пришли в Гиву к ___, они рассказали народу.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Страх Господа охватил ___, и они выступили все как один.
cases.explain: The transitive verb охватил requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда Саул построил их в Везеке, мужчин Израиля было триста тысяч ___, а мужчин Иудеи — тридцать тысяч.
cases.explain: After numerals like 'тысяч' (thousands), the genitive plural is used.

cases.sentence: На следующий день Саул разделил своих людей на три ___.
cases.explain: After the numeral три (three), the genitive is required.

cases.sentence: Очень веселился там Саул вместе со всеми ___.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) requires the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Аманитянин Нахаш пришел и осадил Иовеш Галаадский.
reading.question: Who attacked and besieged Jabesh Gilead?
reading.explain: The text clearly states that Nahash the Ammonite came and besieged Jabesh Gilead.

reading.ru: Я заключу с вами союз только на том условии, что выколю каждому из вас правый глаз.
reading.question: What was the terrible condition Nahash demanded for a covenant?
options: He would gouge out the right eye of each man
He would enslave all the people
He would take all their possessions
reading.correct: He would gouge out the right eye of each man
reading.explain: Nahash demanded that he could put out the right eye of every man as the condition for making a covenant.

reading.ru: Дай нам семь дней, чтобы мы могли послать вестников по всему Израилю.
reading.question: What did the elders of Jabesh ask for?
options: Seven days to send messengers throughout Israel
reading.correct: Seven days to send messengers throughout Israel
reading.explain: The elders of Jabesh requested seven days so they could send messengers to all Israel.

reading.ru: Когда Саул услышал их слова, дух Бога сошел на него, и Саул разгневался.
reading.question: How did Saul react when he heard about Jabesh's situation?
options: The Spirit of God came upon him and his anger burned hot
He was afraid and consulted with Samuel
He declared a period of mourning
reading.correct: The Spirit of God came upon him and his anger burned hot
reading.explain: The text says the Spirit of God came mightily upon Saul when he heard the words, and his anger burned hot.

reading.ru: Страх Господа охватил народ, и они выступили все как один.
reading.question: What was the response of the people of Israel after Saul's action?
options: The fear of the Lord fell on them and they came out as one man
They sent delegates to the enemy
They asked for more time to prepare
reading.correct: The fear of the Lord fell on them and they came out as one man
reading.explain: The dread of Yahweh fell on the people, and they came out to join Saul as one man.

reading.ru: Весь народ пошел в Гилгал и утвердил Саула царем в присутствии Господа.
reading.question: What happened after Saul's victory over the Ammonites?
options: All the people went to Gilgal and made Saul king before the Lord
reading.correct: All the people went to Gilgal and made Saul king before the Lord
reading.explain: All Israel went to Gilgal and made Saul king before the Lord in Gilgal.
